newsitem.title: USA: Mont. Colstrip 3 back on line, unit 2 seen up Fri.
newsitem.headline: Mont. Colstrip 3 back on line, unit 2 seen up Fri.

text.p: The 700 megawatt (MW) unit 3 at the Colstrip coal-fired power plant near Billings, Mont., was at full power after being shut early this week for unplanned repairs, a Montana Power Co spokesman said Thursday.
Colstrip's 330 MW unit 2, which has been shut for work on its cooling towers, is expected to restart Friday morning, the spokesman said.
Colstrip's 700 MW unit 4 and 330 unit 1 were said to be operating normally.
Montana Power is the operator of the Colstrip plant and is responsible for the sale of 30 percent of unit 4's power ouptut under long-term contracts.

Equity owners include Puget Sound Power and Light Co, Washington Water Power Co, Portland General Electric Co, Pacific Power and Light, and a consortium of GE Credit, Shell Oil Co and a lease-back firm.
